Threshold height<-0.001 in scene coordinates. No millimeter calibration, physical contact solve, opaque coverage or visual acceptance.

candidate_surface_proxy.scope: Signed analytic ellipsoid implicit/gradient height approximation on actual saved float32 Catmull controls; order8 sampling plus controls. guide_geometry.basis: Actual float32 controls promoted to float64; uniform Catmull-Rom with duplicated endpoints, Gauss integration order32 for arcs.
